phrase.acid: two bars of degrees 1 (accented) and 5, each held three sixteenths and followed by five of rest
phrase.drums: two bars hitting only the control's own lane (bd_tune plays bd) on every beat, so the lane is measured alone
phrase.kit: two bars of a model.kick lane hit on beats one and three
phrase.method: low and high are half and twice the default for times, frequencies and ratios, otherwise the default minus and plus a quarter of the range, kept inside the range; an instrument parameter without a range takes half and twice its default, or plus and minus 0.25 when it lies within 0..1
phrase.notes: two bars of c3 and g3, each held three sixteenths and followed by five sixteenths of rest
